title: Wagers
subtitle: Markets on AFC matches: open them, watch them, settle them from the result.
money.title: Winnings
money.subtitle: What the house earns, what it owes, and every naira that moves.
resolutions.VOID_SOLO_WAGER: One side only: every stake returned
resolutions.VOID_ADMIN: Voided by an admin: every stake returned
markets.empty: No markets yet. Make the first one.
queue.intro: Locked markets wait for the match result; once it is in, the suggestion appears with its evidence. Confirm it, or pick another winner with a reason.
queue.pool: Pool {pool} · {n, plural, =0 {no wagers} one {# wager} other {# wagers}}
settle.title: Settle {title}
settle.intro: Pool {pool}. The house keeps {rake}% and the rest goes to the winning side in proportion to their stakes.
settle.noSuggestion: No suggestion yet. Ask the stats again once the match result is in.
settle.wagersOn: {n, plural, =0 {no wagers} one {# wager} other {# wagers}}
settle.noWinnerNote: Nobody backed this option: every stake will be returned.
settle.overrideReason: Why a different winner than suggested
settle.overridePlaceholder: Say what the stats missed. This is kept on the settlement record.
void.title: Void {title}
void.intro: {pool} across {n, plural, =0 {no wagers} one {# wager} other {# wagers}} goes back to the players in full. No fee, no rake.
void.reasonPlaceholder: Shown to every player on this market.
reopen.title: Reopen {title}
reopen.intro: Stakes are accepted again until the new lock time.
detail.draftHint: A draft is invisible to players. It has {n, plural, =0 {no options} one {# option} other {# options}}; it needs at least two to publish.
detail.openHint: Players can stake until the lock time. Lock it early if the match starts sooner.
detail.lockedHint: Waiting for the match result. The sweep asks the stats every minute; you can also ask now.
detail.pendingHint: The suggestion is in. Confirm it or pick another winner.
form.newSubtitle: Pick what it is about, who can be backed, and when it locks.
form.noMatches: This event has no matches yet.
form.title: Title
form.descriptionHint: One or two lines under the title.
form.rulesHint: Anything a player should know before staking: ties, no-shows, what counts.
form.optionsLocked: Options cannot change once a market is open or has stakes.
form.pickTemplateFirst: Pick a kind of market first.
form.lineHint: Over and under this number of total kills.
form.noTeams: No teams are registered for this event.
form.noPlayers: No players are on the rosters of this event.
form.optionCount: {n, plural, =0 {No options yet} one {# option} other {# options}} · at least two
form.lockAtHint: No new stakes after this. Usually the match start.
form.openAtHint: Leave empty to open as soon as it is published.
form.moneyHint: These start from the settings defaults. Percentages and whole naira.
templates.intro: A kind of market pairs who can be backed with how the winner is read from the match stats.
settings.enabledOn: Wagering is on: players can place stakes.
settings.enabledOff: Wagering is paused: no new stakes. Open markets stay visible; cancels and withdrawals keep working.
settings.switchHint: Flip this to pause the whole feature at once.
settings.maintenancePlaceholder: Shown on the wagers page while wagering is paused.
settings.defaultsHint: Every new market copies these; each can be changed on the market itself.
settings.rakeHint: Taken from the pool at settlement. At most 20%.
settings.cancelFeeHint: Kept when a player cancels before the lock. At most 10%.
settings.paymentExpiryHint: An unpaid stake expires after this.
settings.cosignHint: A withdrawal or adjustment above this needs a second, different admin.
settings.capsHint: Applied to any player who has not set their own. A player can only go lower.
overview.paused: Wagering is paused. Players cannot place new stakes.
overview.toSettle: Markets with a suggestion to confirm
overview.lockedWaiting: Locked markets waiting for a result
player.kycForced: The WhatsApp confirmation was set by hand.
player.kycLink: Force or undo on the KYC tab
player.withdrawalsLink: Decide withdrawals on the Withdrawals tab
player.freezeIntro: A frozen account cannot withdraw. Stakes and settlements still work. The player is told.
player.unfreezeIntro: Withdrawals work again. The player is told.
player.adjustIntro: A credit or debit with a reason, written to the ledger with your name. Above the two-key threshold a second admin has to co-sign.
player.adjustReasonPlaceholder: Why, in one line. The player reads this.
player.limitsIntro: Tighten a player's caps or put them on a break. Loosening follows the same 24 hour rule the player has.
withdrawals.intro: Approve sends the transfer through Paystack. Above the two-key threshold the first approval only signs; a different admin approves again.
withdrawals.rejectIntro: {amount} for {user} goes back to their available Winnings. They read the reason.
withdrawals.rejectPlaceholder: For example: the account name does not match the profile.
adjustments.intro: Credits and debits admins made. Make one from a player's page.
kyc.intro: A withdrawal needs a confirmed WhatsApp number and a linked Discord. Force or undo the WhatsApp confirmation here, with a reason kept on record.
kyc.forceIntro: This changes what {user} can do. Say why.
kyc.reasonPlaceholder: For example: number confirmed on a support call on 19 September.
